statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting SP 800-171 and PCI DSS
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level
Division supplements may not weaken group policy; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document and confirm common control inheritance
Security plan for every system with CUI, FCI, or cardholder data
No SPRS score, CMMC affirmation, or attestation without a full-scope assessment
Service provider review; FedRAMP Moderate or equivalency for cloud services holding CUI
Authorized sources first for federal orders; brokers only after assessment
Manufacturer of record for every SKU; covered-manufacturer block on federal orders and refurbished stock
Serial validation and tamper inspection at every DC; quarantine until release
Flowdown of clauses and subcontractor CMMC status verification
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identities; no shared accounts including handhelds
Role-based least privilege; CUI roster approval
MFA for all workforce; phishing-resistant for administrators and FFE users; MFA into the CDE
Service accounts owned, governed, and rotated
Termination within 4 hours; agency accounts expire automatically
Quarterly certification; inactive accounts disabled
Just-in-time privileged access through PAM
Vendor and OT maintenance access only through PAM; no persistent tunnels
No CUI on systems outside the CMMC scope
MFA for reseller administrators, 3PL client users, and sellers
Report suspected incidents and suspect products within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Record the start of each notice clock
At least four DIBNet certificate holders in two locations
Notification matrix owned by counsel; counsel approves notices
Severity 1 to the disclosure committee within 24 hours; 8-K within 4 business days of materiality
Suspect products quarantined and kept until disposition
Annual cross-division exercise with the matrix and a materiality decision
Evidence preserved; images kept 90 days after a DFARS report
CUI only in the FFE and the government-community tenant
FCI only in systems and services that meet FAR 52.204-21
No stored cardholder data; no card data in call recordings
Encryption at rest and in transit; FIPS-validated for CUI
Seller compliance data used only for compliance; restricted access
Immutable, separate, restore-tested backups
NIST SP 800-88 sanitization with verification sampling on every line
Removable storage blocked; none on FFE workstations
Annual awareness training including phishing; quarterly exercises
Role-based training: CUI, anti-counterfeit, payment handling
Managed devices only; no CUI on mobile devices or at alternate sites
Approved generative AI tools only; no regulated data in public tools
Bank detail changes only through the portal with call-back
